capabilities: strip selected characters in char or regex mode
apply presets from a floating toolbar, context menu, or command palette
manage, import, and export custom presets
use an eraser brush that auto-applies a preset on each selection
extras: The README states all code was written by AI with human involvement limited to release testing and change requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-click way to delete chosen characters or regex patterns from selected text.

relations.evidence: The floating toolbar interaction design and settings page tab design were inspired by editing-toolbar

summary: Selection-based text stripper that removes user-defined characters or regex matches via toolbar, context menu, or commands.
